"It's Hard to Be a Saint in the City", "Does This Bus Stop at 82nd Street?", "Growin' Up", "You Can Look (But You Better Not Touch)", "Sherry Darling", "Save My Love", "Fade Away", "Darlington County", and "Bobby Jean" were not on the setlist. Soundcheck included: "New York City Serenade", "4th of July, Asbury Park (Sandy)" and "Stayin' Alive".
